text:
carlos: heads-up: after today's runtime unpin some APAC dedicated hosts showing model mismatch errors. Thinking we should apply a region-scoped runtime pin to avoid broader customer impact. pinging ops + sres for quick decision.

deploy-bot: [scan] mismatch-alert: 7 hosts in apac-dedicated-1 reported model-binding errors for models in family: gptx-small. Suggested mitigation: add runtime-pin: runtime@3.1.2 to apac-dedicated-1.
lina: can we do a partial pin by affinity tag instead of entire region? some latency-sensitive tenants rely on the newer runtime.
carlos: yes, propose tag=legacy-llwrap for customers using gptx-small; pin only that affinity group. lower blast radius.
jamie: ops: do we have automation to target affinity pins?
ops-bot: automation-capable: yes -> `/deploy pin runtime apac-dedicated-1 --tag legacy-llwrap --version runtime@3.1.2 --reason "model-binding regressions post-unpin"` will apply. Change window recommended 30m.
natalie: +1 from eng-runtime. Short-term pin while we backport binding fix. We'll prepare a staged runtime build.
qa-bot: quick smoke summary on affected hosts (latest):
- api_surface: PASS
- model_bind: FAIL (bind error 502 in 5/7 hosts)
- perf_baseline: PASS
link: https://ci.redwood/internal/testruns/892001

carlos: schedule: apply pin in 10 mins, smoke run at +15m, unpin at +6h if a backport patch lands. rollback command: `/deploy rollback apac-dedicated-1 --to runtime@3.1.2 --tag legacy-llwrap` and to remove pin: `/deploy pinlist remove apac-dedicated-1 runtime-pin:runtime@3.1.2:tag=legacy-llwrap`.
lina: add note for release notes: "apac-dedicated-1 scoped runtime pin for legacy-llwrap tenants due to model-binding regressions; temporary".
jamie: ops will run the apply, I'll monitor logs. If any telemetry crosses threshold (error-rate > 1%), we abort and open incident.
deploy-bot: action queued: apply runtime pin -> target=apac-dedicated-1, tag=legacy-llwrap, version=runtime@3.1.2, requested_by=carlos, runbook=/runbooks/apac-runtime-pin.md

ops-bot: [info] scheduling maintenance window: start=1716200060, duration=30m, change_id=chg-20240323-apac-pin

deploy-bot: [completed] runtime pin applied (id=pin-20240323-02) to apac-dedicated-1 tag=legacy-llwrap at 1716200085

natalie: prepping backport PR now. target image: runtime:3.1.3-backport. will post PR and image digest here when ready.
qa-bot: smoke results (post-pin): model_bind: PASS on 6/7 hosts (one host had transient kube-probe flakiness), api_surface: PASS, perf_baseline: PASS. details: https://ci.redwood/internal/testruns/892003

carlos: thanks. keeping timeline: leave pin for 6h or until backport validated. ops note: record change in change-log and notify customers on legacy-llwrap list.
lina: also add a small note to rollforward guidance: if backport fails, we will coordinate a soft rollback of the initial unpin in the broader fleet.
jamie: monitoring dashboard: https://dash.redwood/apac/runtime/blend. tagging @oncall for visibility. :eyes:
